picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant renewal to sustain MassAITC signals strong federal commitment to AI-driven aging and Alzheimer's care research, pairing a major university with a leading health system.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL, Google, and Northeastern's 'InstructMesh' tool solves a real bottleneck in AI-generated 3D fabrication by letting users repair structurally broken models, a practical step toward trustworthy generative design.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: A cross-institutional team from MIT, CMU, NYU, and Stanford built an AI that beat top humans at Stratego, a landmark for imperfect-information game AI with implications beyond games, such as negotiation and strategic planning under uncertainty.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip from AUC offers rapid, low-cost disease pre-screening for conditions like leukemia and hepatitis, a promising step toward accessible diagnostics in resource-limited settings.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's $8M in federal Strengthening Institutions grants will expand AI education and workforce training, broadening access to AI skills development.
picks.title: UCR receives $8 million in federal grants

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine learning tool estimates past radiation exposure from a routine blood test, offering a faster and more accessible alternative to specialized bioassays with clear public-health and emergency-response value.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: Inria's voice-analysis decision-support tool for detecting heart attacks during emergency calls could meaningfully speed up triage and treatment in time-critical cardiac events.
picks.title: Samu-Voice: Analyzing voice and speech to detect acute transmural myocardial infarctions

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's AI models help pathologists spot precancerous colon lesions that are hard to detect by eye, a concrete example of AI improving diagnostic accuracy in cancer screening.
picks.title: AI is helping pathologists find harmful lesions the eye can’t see

picks.editorial_note: Harvard's Belfer Center 'pre-mortem' report warns that catastrophic AI risks remain preventable but urgent, citing concrete incidents like rogue-agent breaches, a notable contribution to the AI safety policy debate.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: A new CRADA between Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory to research space-based AI-inference computing for weather modeling pairs defense-lab expertise with commercial space infrastructure in a novel application area.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling
